verdict.rationale: Bruno offers collection-level documentation that can be published as shareable HTML and a README badge/button linking to a shared workspace or collection, which gives limited discoverability, but there is no evidence of a true internal API catalog/portal, search across teams, governance, or discovery UX comparable to a dedicated developer portal. missing for 10: a dedicated catalog/portal product, cross-team search/discovery, access governance, and any customer proof of portal usage.
